reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 15.5 selects New York law without conflict-of-laws reference, which is the playbook's preferred governing law, and the deterministic check on the accepted law set passes.

The dispute forum is JAMS arbitration under its Comprehensive Arbitration Rules — a U.S.-administered process with court carve-outs for patent/trademark scope and validity (15.6(h)) and interim/equitable relief (15.6(j)) — so it is not the walk-away scenario of vendor home-jurisdiction law or arbitration seated abroad.

Departure from the preferred New York County court venue is a sub-element short of preferred wording; under the playbook's classification semantics it is properly noted in the rationale rather than redlined, and the redacted seat/arbitrator count is correctly raised as a point to confirm on turn rather than flagged as a deviation.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.
